  /v1/chat/completions:
    post:
      tags:
      - OpenAI Compatible
      summary: Create chat completion
      description: |-
        Creates a chat completion for the given messages. Drop-in replacement for the OpenAI Chat Completions API — accepts the same request schema and returns the same response format, including `usage` with token counts.

        The router resolves the requested model to an upstream provider, forwards the request, and returns the response. Supports both synchronous and streaming modes.

        When `stream: true`, the response is sent as Server-Sent Events (SSE) where each `data` line contains a `ChatCompletionChunk` JSON object. The stream ends with `data: [DONE]`.
      operationId: createChatCompletion
      requestBody:
        description: Chat completion request. The router forwards a slightly enriched version of this body to the resolved upstream provider.
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
              title: ChatRequest
              description: |-
                Chat Completions request body
                (<https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create>).

                `pub` so downstream crates (notably `bitrouter-cloud`) can derive an
                OpenAPI schema from the canonical wire shape without redeclaring it.
              type: object
              properties:
                frequency_penalty:
                  description: |-
                    Frequency penalty. Promoted to the canonical `frequency_penalty` slot.
                    <https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create#chat-create-frequency_penalty>
                  type:
                  - number
                  - 'null'
                  format: double
                  default: null
                max_completion_tokens:
                  type:
                  - integer
                  - 'null'
                  format: uint32
                  default: null
                  minimum: 0
                max_tokens:
                  type:
                  - integer
                  - 'null'
                  format: uint32
                  default: null
                  minimum: 0
                messages:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    $ref: '#/$defs/ChatMessage'
                model:
                  type: string
                parallel_tool_calls:
                  description: Whether the model may issue tool calls in parallel.
                  type:
                  - boolean
                  - 'null'
                  default: null
                presence_penalty:
                  description: |-
                    Presence penalty. Promoted to the canonical `presence_penalty` slot.
                    <https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create#chat-create-presence_penalty>
                  type:
                  - number
                  - 'null'
                  format: double
                  default: null
                reasoning_effort:
                  anyOf:
                  - $ref: '#/$defs/ReasoningEffort'
                  - type: 'null'
                  default: null
                response_format:
                  description: |-
                    Output-format constraint. The `json_schema` variant is the
                    structured-output contract; `json_object` is the legacy JSON mode and
                    `text` is the default. Promoted to the canonical `response_format` slot
                    at parse time (`json_object` / `text` pass through opaquely).
                    <https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs>
                  anyOf:
                  - $ref: '#/$defs/ChatResponseFormat'
                  - type: 'null'
                  default: null
                seed:
                  description: |-
                    Deterministic-sampling seed. Promoted to the canonical `seed` slot so it
                    translates across protocols (e.g. to a Gemini upstream's
                    `generationConfig.seed`) instead of no-op'ing as a top-level key on a
                    nested-config wire.
                    <https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create#chat-create-seed>
                  type:
                  - integer
                  - 'null'
                  format: int64
                  default: null
                stop:
                  description: |-
                    Stop sequences — a single string or an array of up to four. Promoted to
                    the canonical `stop` slot.
                    <https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/chat/create#chat-create-stop>
                  default: null
                store:
                  description: Whether OpenAI may retain the request and response.
                  type:
                  - boolean
                  - 'null'
                  default: null
                stream:
                  type: boolean
                  default: false
                stream_options:
                  description: Streaming response controls.
                  anyOf:
                  - $ref: '#/$defs/ChatStreamOptions'
                  - type: 'null'
                  default: null
                temperature:
                  type:
                  - number
                  - 'null'
                  format: double
                  default: null
                tools:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    $ref: '#/$defs/ChatTool'
                top_p:
                  type:
                  - number
                  - 'null'
                  format: double
                  default: null
              required:
              - model
              - messages
              $defs:
                ChatFunctionCall:
                  description: 'The `function` payload of a [`ChatToolCall`]: name + raw JSON argument string.'
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    arguments:
                      type: string
                      default: ''
                    name:
                      type: string
                      default: ''
                ChatJsonSchema:
                  description: The `json_schema` payload of [`ChatResponseFormat::JsonSchema`].
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    description:
                      description: |-
                        Optional schema description — extra LLM guidance OpenAI passes through to
                        the model. Promoted to the canonical `response_format` description.
                        <https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs>
                      type:
                      - string
                      - 'null'
                    name:
                      description: Schema name (OpenAI requires it).
                      type: string
                    schema:
                      description: The JSON Schema.
                    strict:
                      description: Strict-mode flag.
                      type:
                      - boolean
                      - 'null'
                  required:
                  - name
                  - schema
                ChatMessage:
                  description: |-
                    One element of [`ChatRequest`]'s `messages` array — a chat turn carrying
                    role + optional content + optional tool calls / tool-call reply id.
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    content:
                      description: |-
                        `content` may be a plain string or an array of content parts, or absent
                        (an assistant turn that is purely `tool_calls`).
                      default: null
                    reasoning_content:
                      description: |-
                        Reasoning content — **not** in OpenAI's Chat Completions spec; this is
                        a vendor extension used by DeepSeek
                        (<https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/create-chat-completion>), Moonshot
                        (Kimi), Qwen, and other OpenAI-compatible providers that expose the
                        model's chain-of-thought on the Chat envelope. v0 #454-1: it must
                        not be dropped. `parse_response` additionally accepts `reasoning`
                        (some OpenRouter passthroughs) and `thinking` (Aliyun) as aliases.
                      type:
                      - string
                      - 'null'
                      default: null
                    role:
                      type: string
                    tool_call_id:
                      type:
                      - string
                      - 'null'
                      default: null
                    tool_calls:
                      type: array
                      items:
                        $ref: '#/$defs/ChatToolCall'
                  required:
                  - role
                ChatResponseFormat:
                  description: |-
                    Chat Completions `response_format`
                    (<https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/structured-outputs>) — a closed
                    union over OpenAI's three output modes.
                  oneOf:
                  - description: Free-form text — the default.
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      type:
                        type: string
                        const: text
                    required:
                    - type
                  - description: 'Legacy JSON mode: valid JSON with no schema.'
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      type:
                        type: string
                        const: json_object
                    required:
                    - type
                  - description: JSON constrained to a schema.
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      json_schema:
                        description: The schema spec.
                        $ref: '#/$defs/ChatJsonSchema'
                      type:
                        type: string
                        const: json_schema
                    required:
                    - type
                    - json_schema
                ChatStreamOptions:
                  description: |-
                    Chat Completions streaming request options.

                    These options belong to the Chat Completions wire rather than the
                    protocol-neutral streaming response. Keeping them typed prevents a Chat
                    client's top-level object from leaking into Messages, Responses, or Gemini
                    requests while preserving same-protocol extensions through [`Self::extra`].
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    include_obfuscation:
                      description: Ask OpenAI not to add obfuscation bytes to streaming deltas.
                      type:
                      - boolean
                      - 'null'
                    include_usage:
                      description: Ask the upstream to emit a final usage-only streaming chunk.
                      type:
                      - boolean
                      - 'null'
                ChatTool:
                  description: 'One element of [`ChatRequest`]''s `tools` array — a `{ function: { … } }` envelope.'
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    function:
                      $ref: '#/$defs/ChatToolFunction'
                ChatToolCall:
                  description: One assistant tool-call entry on a [`ChatMessage`].
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    function:
                      $ref: '#/$defs/ChatFunctionCall'
                    id:
                      type: string
                  required:
                  - id
                ChatToolFunction:
                  description: |-
                    The `function` payload of a [`ChatTool`]: name + description + JSON-Schema
                    parameters + optional `strict` flag.
                    <https://platform.openai.com/docs/guides/function-calling#strict-mode>
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    description:
                      type:
                      - string
                      - 'null'
                      default: null
                    name:
                      type: string
                    parameters:
                      default: null
                    strict:
                      description: |-
                        OpenAI strict-mode flag (V3 `strict`). Captured so it is not lost across
                        the canonical boundary.
                      type:
                      - boolean
                      - 'null'
                      default: null
                  required:
                  - name
                ReasoningEffort:
                  description: |-
                    Qualitative reasoning-effort levels understood by BitRouter's built-in
                    OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini protocol adapters.

                    This is the cross-provider superset, not a claim that every model supports
                    every value. Exact provider/model routes advertise their supported subset
                    separately and policy-owned effort targets are validated against it before
                    dispatch.
                  oneOf:
                  - description: Disable reasoning where the selected model supports doing so.
                    type: string
                    const: none
                  - description: Use the smallest non-zero reasoning setting exposed by the model.
                    type: string
                    const: minimal
                  - description: Prefer low reasoning cost and latency.
                    type: string
                    const: low
                  - description: Balance reasoning depth with cost and latency.
                    type: string
                    const: medium
                  - description: Prefer deeper reasoning over cost and latency.
                    type: string
                    const: high
                  - description: Use the provider's extra-high reasoning setting.
                    type: string
                    const: xhigh
                  - description: Use the provider's maximum reasoning setting.
                    type: string
                    const: max
        required: true
      responses:
        '200':
          description: |-
            Chat completion response (non-streaming).

            Streamed chat completion — Server-Sent Events with one `ChatCompletionChunk` per `data:` line, terminated by `data: [DONE]`.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                title: ChatCompletionResponseDoc
                description: 'MIRROR: `bitrouter_sdk::language_model::protocol::chat_completions` response'
                type: object
                properties:
                  choices:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/$defs/ChatCompletionChoiceDoc'
                  created:
                    description: Unix timestamp (seconds) of when the completion was created.
                    type: integer
                    format: uint64
                    minimum: 0
                  id:
                    description: A unique identifier for the completion.
                    type: string
                  model:
                    description: The model used for the completion.
                    type: string
                  object:
                    description: Object type — always `chat.completion`.
                    type: string
                  usage:
                    anyOf:
                    - $ref: '#/$defs/ChatCompletionUsageDoc'
                    - type: 'null'
                required:
                - id
                - object
                - created
                - model
                - choices
                $defs:
                  ChatCompletionChoiceDoc:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      finish_reason:
                        type:
                        - string
                        - 'null'
                      index:
                        type: integer
                        format: uint32
                        minimum: 0
                      message:
                        $ref: '#/$defs/ChatCompletionMessageDoc'
                    required:
                    - index
                    - message
                  ChatCompletionMessageDoc:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      content:
                        type:
                        - string
                        - 'null'
                      role:
                        type: string
                    required:
                    - role
                  ChatCompletionUsageDoc:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      completion_tokens:
                        type: integer
                        format: uint32
                        minimum: 0
                      prompt_tokens:
                        type: integer
                        format: uint32
                        minimum: 0
                      total_tokens:
                        type: integer
                        format: uint32
                        minimum: 0
                    required:
                    - prompt_tokens
                    - completion_tokens
                    - total_tokens
            text/event-stream:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                title: ChatCompletionChunkDoc
                description: |-
                  MIRROR: a single SSE `data:` payload in the streaming `/v1/chat/completions`
                  response. Used to type the `text/event-stream` content for the same route.
                type: object
                properties:
                  choices:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: '#/$defs/ChatCompletionChunkChoiceDoc'
                  created:
                    type: integer
                    format: uint64
                    minimum: 0
                  id:
                    type: string
                  model:
                    type: string
                  object:
                    type: string
                  usage:
                    anyOf:
                    - $ref: '#/$defs/ChatCompletionUsageDoc'
                    - type: 'null'
                required:
                - id
                - object
                - created
                - model
                - choices
                $defs:
                  ChatCompletionChunkChoiceDoc:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      delta:
                        $ref: '#/$defs/ChatCompletionChunkDeltaDoc'
                      finish_reason:
                        type:
                        - string
                        - 'null'
                      index:
                        type: integer
                        format: uint32
                        minimum: 0
                    required:
                    - index
                    - delta
                  ChatCompletionChunkDeltaDoc:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      content:
                        type:
                        - string
                        - 'null'
                      role:
                        type:
                        - string
                        - 'null'
                  ChatCompletionUsageDoc:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      completion_tokens:
                        type: integer
                        format: uint32
                        minimum: 0
                      prompt_tokens:
                        type: integer
                        format: uint32
                        minimum: 0
                      total_tokens:
                        type: integer
                        format: uint32
                        minimum: 0
                    required:
                    - prompt_tokens
                    - completion_tokens
                    - total_tokens
        '400':
          description: Bad request — invalid model or malformed request body.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                title: ErrorResponseDoc
                description: |-
                  MIRROR: the JSON shape `bitrouter_sdk::error::BitrouterError` serialises into
                  (`{ "error": { "code": ..., "message": ..., "type": ... } }`). Cloud handlers map to
                  this envelope via `BitrouterError::into_response`.
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    $ref: '#/$defs/ErrorBodyDoc'
                required:
                - error
                $defs:
                  ErrorBodyDoc:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. `upstream_rate_limited`).
                        type: string
                      message:
                        description: Human-readable error description.
                        type: string
                      type:
                        description: Broad OpenAI-compatible error category (e.g. `rate_limit_error`).
                        type: string
                    required:
                    - code
                    - message
                    - type
        '402':
          description: Payment required — insufficient balance or missing payment proof.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
                title: ErrorResponseDoc
                description: |-
                  MIRROR: the JSON shape `bitrouter_sdk::error::BitrouterError` serialises into
                  (`{ "error": { "code": ..., "message": ..., "type": ... } }`). Cloud handlers map to
                  this envelope via `BitrouterError::into_response`.
                type: object
                properties:
                  error:
                    $ref: '#/$defs/ErrorBodyDoc'
                required:
                - error
                $defs:
                  ErrorBodyDoc:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      code:
                        description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. `upstream_rate_limited`).
                        type: string

  /v1/responses:
    post:
      tags:
      - OpenAI Responses
      summary: Create response
      description: |-
        Creates a response using the OpenAI Responses API format. Drop-in replacement for OpenAI's newer stateful-conversation surface.

        When `stream: true`, the response is sent as Server-Sent Events (SSE) with the full output-item lifecycle (`response.created`, `response.output_item.added`, `response.output_text.delta`, `response.completed`, …). The cloud forwards the upstream provider's SSE stream unchanged.
      operationId: createResponse
      requestBody:
        description: OpenAI Responses API request.
        content:
          application/json:
            example:
              model: anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
              input: Hello!
            schema:
              $schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
              title: ResponsesRequest
              description: |-
                Responses request body
                (<https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses/create>).

                `pub` so downstream crates (notably `bitrouter-cloud`) can derive an
                OpenAPI schema from the canonical wire shape without redeclaring it.

                `input` stays `serde_json::Value` on purpose — the Responses API accepts
                either a plain string or a heterogeneous item array (Codex multi-turn,
                #454-3), and the deeper walk happens in `parse_input` (private). Mirrors
                how Anthropic's `system` / `content` are typed.
              type: object
              properties:
                input: true
                instructions:
                  type:
                  - string
                  - 'null'
                  default: null
                max_output_tokens:
                  type:
                  - integer
                  - 'null'
                  format: uint32
                  default: null
                  minimum: 0
                model:
                  type: string
                  default: ''
                parallel_tool_calls:
                  description: Whether the model may issue tool calls in parallel.
                  type:
                  - boolean
                  - 'null'
                  default: null
                reasoning:
                  anyOf:
                  - $ref: '#/$defs/ResponsesReasoningConfig'
                  - type: 'null'
                store:
                  description: Whether OpenAI may retain the request and response.
                  type:
                  - boolean
                  - 'null'
                  default: null
                stream:
                  type: boolean
                  default: false
                temperature:
                  type:
                  - number
                  - 'null'
                  format: double
                  default: null
                text:
                  description: |-
                    Output `text` config — `format` is the structured-output constraint
                    (`json_schema` is promoted to the canonical slot; `text` / `json_object`
                    pass through). Sibling keys (e.g. `verbosity`) survive via `extra`.
                  anyOf:
                  - $ref: '#/$defs/ResponsesText'
                  - type: 'null'
                tools:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    $ref: '#/$defs/ResponsesTool'
                top_p:
                  type:
                  - number
                  - 'null'
                  format: double
                  default: null
              required:
              - input
              $defs:
                ReasoningEffort:
                  description: |-
                    Qualitative reasoning-effort levels understood by BitRouter's built-in
                    OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini protocol adapters.

                    This is the cross-provider superset, not a claim that every model supports
                    every value. Exact provider/model routes advertise their supported subset
                    separately and policy-owned effort targets are validated against it before
                    dispatch.
                  oneOf:
                  - description: Disable reasoning where the selected model supports doing so.
                    type: string
                    const: none
                  - description: Use the smallest non-zero reasoning setting exposed by the model.
                    type: string
                    const: minimal
                  - description: Prefer low reasoning cost and latency.
                    type: string
                    const: low
                  - description: Balance reasoning depth with cost and latency.
                    type: string
                    const: medium
                  - description: Prefer deeper reasoning over cost and latency.
                    type: string
                    const: high
                  - description: Use the provider's extra-high reasoning setting.
                    type: string
                    const: xhigh
                  - description: Use the provider's maximum reasoning setting.
                    type: string
                    const: max
                ResponsesReasoningConfig:
                  description: |-
                    `reasoning` knob on [`ResponsesRequest`]. `effort` is promoted to the
                    canonical slot; sibling fields such as `summary` round-trip via `extra`.
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    effort:
                      anyOf:
                      - $ref: '#/$defs/ReasoningEffort'
                      - type: 'null'
                      default: null
                ResponsesText:
                  description: |-
                    Responses `text` config. `format` constrains output shape; sibling keys
                    (e.g. `verbosity`) pass through via `extra`.
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    format:
                      anyOf:
                      - $ref: '#/$defs/ResponsesTextFormat'
                      - type: 'null'
                      default: null
                ResponsesTextFormat:
                  description: |-
                    Responses `text.format`
                    (<https://platform.openai.com/docs/api-reference/responses/create>) — a
                    closed union over OpenAI's three output modes.
                  oneOf:
                  - description: Free-form text — the default.
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      type:
                        type: string
                        const: text
                    required:
                    - type
                  - description: Legacy JSON mode.
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      type:
                        type: string
                        const: json_object
                    required:
                    - type
                  - description: JSON constrained to a schema.
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      description:
                        description: |-
                          Optional schema description — extra LLM guidance OpenAI passes to the
                          model. Promoted to the canonical `response_format` description.

                        type:
                        - string
                        - 'null'
                      name:
                        description: Schema name (OpenAI requires it).
                        type: string
                      schema:
                        description: The JSON Schema.

                        description: Strict-mode flag.
                        type:

                      type:

                        const: json_schema
                    required:
                    - type
                    - name
                    - schema
                ResponsesTool:
                  description: |-
                    One element of [`ResponsesRequest`]'s `tools` array.

                    Responses uses one flat array for both kinds of tool:
                    - a **function** tool — `{type:"function", name, description?, parameters, strict?}`;
                    - a **provider-defined** server tool — `{type:"web_search_preview"|…, …config}`

                  properties:
                    description:

                      - string
                      - 'null'
                      default: null

                      - string
                      - 'null'
                      default: null
                    parameters:
                      default: null

                        is not lost across the canonical boundary.
                      type:

                      default: null

components:
  securitySchemes:
    ApiKeyHeader:
      type: apiKey
      in: header
      name: x-api-key
      description: Anthropic-style API key header.
    BearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: API key or JWT
      description: '`Authorization: Bearer <token>` where `<token>` is either an API key issued by the BitRouter console or a JWT minted from a wallet (CAIP-10 issuer).'
tags:
- name: OpenAI Compatible
  description: OpenAI Chat Completions format. Drop-in compatible with the OpenAI Chat Completions API — accepts the same request schema and returns the same response format.
- name: OpenAI Responses
  description: OpenAI Responses API format. Newer stateful-conversation surface; distinct request/response shape from `/v1/chat/completions`.
- name: Anthropic Compatible
  description: Anthropic-format endpoints. Drop-in compatible with the Anthropic Messages API.
- name: Google Compatible
  description: Google Generative Language API format. The URL encodes the model and streaming verb in a single segment (`models/{model}:generateContent` or `:streamGenerateContent`) — same convention as Google's own API.
- name: Discovery
  description: Public read-only endpoints for inspecting the router's configuration — what models and providers it knows about.
- name: BYOK
  description: Bring-Your-Own-Key endpoints. Returns the node's sealed-box public key so the console can encrypt provider keys client-side; the node never sees plaintext on the write path.
- name: Observability
  description: Operational metrics for scrapers. Not intended for human callers — Prometheus-format text exposition.
- name: Health
  description: Liveness check.
- name: Management
  description: Account-bound management endpoints — API keys, usage, billing, policies, BYOK provider keys, OAuth clients. Every endpoint requires a credential whose principal carries the per-endpoint scope (e.g. `keys:read`, `billing:write`).
